Headline difference +1.16 Mt; net difference in plotted categories +18.34 Mt.
Plotted rows are nonoverlapping exact/aggregate crosswalk categories; scope gaps and restated rows are excluded.
The headline has a wider scope. BTR methane convention is unresolved; the diamond changes only PakEmis.
Differences compare two compilations and do not identify which estimate is closer to actual emissions.
